# Home

This book contains all the documentation for the work I complete over my PhD. Each chapter is made of quarto (.qmd) files in the github repository [psvelayudhan/research](https://github.com/psvelayudhan/research). Some chapters are rendered to include code. The included code is not actually present in this repository, but is being [child-imported](https://bookdown.org/yihui/rmarkdown-cookbook/child-document.html)[^1] from R markdown files that are in project-specific code repositories. Currently, the only linked repository is [psvelayudhan/subtyping-mtbi](https://github.com/psvelayudhan/subtyping-mtbi), which contains the code used for the SNF-ABCD analyses. 

[^1]: Not the same as sourcing R scripts. The Rmarkdown files are structured to be executed sequentially, and each script reads in the data it requires and writes out the data for subsequent analyses to reduce their inter-dependence.

Because this book is expected to contain many analyses that read and write to many different parts of our lab's carbon share, the Rmarkdown files containing the included code are structured to not wreak havoc on every render. All code chunks that do any 'heavy lifting' are set to not execute using the `eval=FALSE` flag. Occasional chunks that do run are self-contained and are expected to simply read and display output generated by the "serious chunks". To reproduce any of the analyses in this book, you must run the linked source code yourself.
